searchText: hello, after PoS there wont be any reorgs longer than Epoch right? after finality we cannot reorg past the finality point? is that correct? Under normal circumstances, no. But Ethereum could be attacked / suffer a major bug and it could be necessary to do an emergency reorg past finalized blocks. There was an discussion going on a while ago. In Besu we have afterwards allowed to do reorgs past finalized blocks: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/974664364466511972/974671778439921664 okay, but if we a running a client, we cant get past that point without restarting it CL wont instruct us to reorg in the previous epoch Re-orgs longer than epoch are still possible though impractical on a healthy network. Past finality reorgs should be supported by ELs, and it's not necessarily requires EL client to be restarted Hello Guys. I have question about validators reward on post merge . When validators received their rewards from proposing, slashing, sync committee, received eth is staked one? or just legacy eth? I know after merge transition, staked eth can't transferred. But I am wondering that where the received reward eth put on? Fee recipient address? All validator rewards are accumulated on the CL (thus locked) except for transaction fees, those are sent to the fee recipient address Validators will receive priority fees post merge. Also not rewards per say but validators will also receive mev post merge if they do things properly <@915497547437576203> Going to be alot of validators who supported 1559 who curse their stupidity post merge 😄 It's true. I do wish I would have got more rewards without EIP1559. But in the end I'm more interested in the value of the token I'm staking than in the reward that the stake provides. EIP1559 adds value to ethereum and eth. There wasn’t a change right before/after but I get that there’s arguments for long term value although we haven’t seen a large decoupling from btc. I guess we will test that again post merge. And will test the "miners create a huge selling pressure" cliché too 😉 Reminder: This channel is not here to speculate on prices or miner costings etc. Could we stay on topic please?

excerpts.author: funnygiulio
excerpts.content: hello, after PoS there wont be any reorgs longer than Epoch right?

excerpts.author: funnygiulio
excerpts.content: after finality we cannot reorg past the finality point? is that correct?

excerpts.author: daniellehrner
excerpts.content:
Under normal circumstances, no. But Ethereum could be attacked / suffer a major bug and it could be necessary to do an emergency reorg past finalized blocks. 

There was an discussion going on a while ago. In Besu we have afterwards allowed to do reorgs past finalized blocks: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/974664364466511972/974671778439921664

excerpts.author: funnygiulio
excerpts.content: okay, but if we a running a client, we cant get past that point without restarting it

excerpts.author: funnygiulio
excerpts.content: CL wont instruct us to reorg in the previous epoch

excerpts.author: m.kalinin
excerpts.content: Re-orgs longer than epoch are still possible though impractical on a healthy network. Past finality reorgs should be supported by ELs, and it's not necessarily requires EL client to be restarted

excerpts.author: johnydony
excerpts.content:
Hello Guys. 
I have question about  validators reward on post merge . 

When validators received their rewards from proposing, slashing, sync committee, received eth is staked one? or just legacy eth?

I know after merge transition, staked eth can't transferred.
But I am wondering that where the received reward eth put on? 
Fee recipient address?

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: All validator rewards are accumulated on the CL (thus locked) except for transaction fees, those are sent to the fee recipient address

excerpts.author: chris2_2_2
excerpts.content:
Validators will receive priority fees post merge. Also not rewards per say but validators will also receive mev post merge if they do things properly <@915497547437576203>

Going to be  alot of validators who supported 1559 who curse their stupidity post merge 😄
